mentions.name: Minimal-Energy Maximal-Efficiency AI Architecture Framework
mentions.description: A framework for determining the minimal-energy, maximal-efficiency architecture for AI models. It calculates precise theoretical limits, such as a 'Cognitive Event Horizon' (where a model becomes so complicated it costs more energy to run than the knowledge it provides) and a 'Semantic Horizon' (where it gets too complex to be accurate), with implications such as a fundamental mathematical maximum learning rate pursued via aggressively filtering training data.
mentions.problem: AI models can become so complex that running them costs more energy than the knowledge they provide, or their complexity makes them too inaccurate.
